correctness.rationale: The separated five-run classification is proved by an exhaustive run-count analysis: two monochromatic maxima, two minimal exits per two-transition orientation, a three-run shorter-one-center pattern, an optional central-zero three-run pattern, and exclusion of four-or-more-run minimal factors by unique proper factors. Separation is explicit in all uses. The product generating function counts ordered separated compositions, symmetry yields exact 2:1 seven/eight proportions, and exceptional tuples have O(n^3) count among Theta(n^4) compositions. verify.py independently enumerates factor occurrence multisets for 1,800 separated small tuples and exact generating coefficients through length 32; finite tests corroborate rather than prove infinity.

value.rationale: Minimal unique substrings are a motivated string-indexing and marker invariant. The first odd five-run configuration has three zero runs and two one-run transitions; central zero length relative to both outer zero lengths governs a genuinely new optional unique factor. The theorem gives a complete infinite-domain factor list, exact rational finite-length composition counts and a nondegenerate 2/3–1/3 limit with O(1/n) rate. These are substantive structural and probabilistic statements, not a routine numerical lookup.
